title: The Long-Only Minimum Variance Portfolio in a One-Factor Market: Theory and Asymptotics
abstract: arXiv:2604.09986v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the long-only minimum variance (LOMV) portfolio, an object of interest going back to Markowitz, and the simplest non-trivial instance of quantitative portfolio construction. Despite its importance, aspects of the LOMV remain mysterious. Here we examine the base case of a general one-factor covariance model, and provide an explicit characterization of the solution. As a corollary we resolve an open question of Qi (2021) for this setting. In the high-dimensional regime of many assets, we prove that the active ratio (proportion of assets with non-zero weight in the LOMV portfolio) converges in almost all cases to a limit expressed in terms of the distribution of asset betas. In particular, when asset betas are all positive and drawn from a continuous distribution, the active ratio tends to zero in the high dimensional limit, and close to zero when the fraction of negative betas is small.

translated_title: 单因子市场中的纯多头最小方差投资组合：理论与渐近分析
translated_abstract: 我们研究纯多头最小方差（LOMV）投资组合，这一研究对象可追溯至马科维茨，是量化投资组合构建中最简单的非平凡实例。尽管其重要性显著，LOMV的某些方面至今仍充满谜团。本文考察了一般单因子协方差模型的基础情形，并给出了该解的显式刻画。作为推论，我们在这一设定下解决了Qi（2021）提出的一个开放问题。在多资产的高维情形下，我们证明了活跃比率（即LOMV投资组合中权重非零的资产比例）在几乎所有情况下收敛于一个由资产贝塔分布表示的极限。特别地，当资产贝塔均为正且服从连续分布时，活跃比率在高维极限下趋于零；而当负贝塔的占比很小时，活跃比率则接近于零。
tldr: 本文对单因子市场中的纯多头最小方差投资组合给出了显式刻画，解决了Qi（2021）的一个开放问题，并证明在多资产高维情形下活跃比率收敛于由资产贝塔分布决定的极限（当贝塔均为正时该比率趋于零）。
en_tdlr: This paper provides an explicit characterization of the long-only minimum variance portfolio in a one-factor market, resolves an open question of Qi (2021), and proves that the active ratio converges in high-dimensional regimes to a limit determined by the asset beta distribution, tending to zero when all betas are positive.
